_readme: Every threshold the sorter uses lives here. Missing keys fall back to the
defaults baked into pogo_sorter.py, so you can delete anything you are
happy with; editing a value here always wins.
Guarantee: BUILD_<role> is only emitted when the mon passes that role's gate.
Borderline mons become REVIEW (kept, not transferred, not built).
Accuracy pass: see the changelog at the top of pogo_sorter.py for the new keys.
2026-10-25 Grok fixes:
- IV product matches PvPoke (floor HP only; atk/def unfloored).
- PvP teams no longer force hard disjoint membership.
- Low-value protections defaulted off; critical ones stay on.
- last_look: extra check block at the top of transfer_list.txt.
- review_triage: sorts the REVIEW pile (advice only, never changes a verdict).
- power_up_priority: top_n / max_per_species / dust_budget (0 = off) / do_not_invest_rows.
- pvp_teams.cup_max_shared_members: cup teams must differ.
2026-10-27 (later): review_triage.confirmed_transfer_ids = in-game ids you approved for transfer.
A REVIEW mon in that list becomes TRANSFER; anything with a keep reason or a raid/Max role is skipped.
2026-10-28 raid moveset advice (never changes a verdict):
- raid.moveset_assume_boost: pick raid attacker moves as if a Mega of their type is active
(boost_same_type x1.3 for moves of that type, boost_other x1.1 for the rest).
- raid.tm_min_gain_pct / elite_tm_min_gain_pct: only suggest a TM when the best pair beats
what the mon can already do by at least this many percent (elite TMs need the bigger gap).
2026-10-28 coverage first:
- coverage.coverage_first: while any raid type has fewer than coverage.min_attackers usable
attackers, Raid and Mega builds target coverage.build_target_level (0 = coverage.min_level, 25)
instead of raid/mega.power_level (40). Gap types are queued first, cheapest first.
Once every type is covered the normal power_level targets come back. Set false to turn off.
- coverage.pick_tie_pct: each open spot goes to the STRONGEST attacker (finished-form raid DPS);
candidates within this percent of the best count as equal and the cheaper one wins.
- coverage.defer_master_builds: while coverage-first is on, Master League projects (power to L50)
are listed at the bottom of build_list.txt. Order only: no verdict changes.
2026-11-02 daily briefing (the old pogo_report.py, now built into the sorter; advice only, never changes a verdict):
- Today tab / briefing.txt: live + upcoming events checked against YOUR teams, wishlist, build queue and transfer list.
- briefing.days: how far ahead to look. cache_hours: how long the event feed is reused. far_off_days: tickets further
away than this go in 'skip'. storage_warn_pct: when the clear-storage card appears.
- CLI: --no-briefing (skip it), --days N, --now "2026-11-02 09:00" (replay a day).
- Needs no key. Offline with no cached feed still gives the account-only advice.
2026-11-02 single-unit rule: a Pokemon in REVIEW or TRANSFER is never recommended anywhere (teams, squads, Megas, buddy,
tanks, power-up lists, wishlist 'HAVE'). A REVIEW copy shows as DECIDE on the wishlist. The self-check enforces this every run.
max_battle.extra_dynamax_dex: dex numbers to add when new Pokemon get Dynamax. extra_gigantamax: {dex: type} for new G-Max.
The sorter also trusts any species your own save holds as Dynamax (and its evolutions).
2026-11-02 placement: every Pokemon gets ONE home type (raid and Max), chosen globally so coverage is as good as possible:
coverage first (coverage.min_attackers per type; usable Pokemon first, then ones you would level; important types first),
then everyone else takes their best home within raid.keep_per_type + reserve_keep per type. TMs assumed. A Mega-capable
Pokemon counts as an attacker OR as the Mega, never both. The viewer's Placement box lists every Pokemon that was re-homed.
2026-11-02 Max Battles: damage = Attack x Max Move power (250/300/350, G-Max 350/400/450) x STAB, ranked at Max Move level 3.
Your real Max Move levels come from the export. max_battle.tank_picks / healer_picks: how many bulk-ranked Dynamax tanks and
healers to list (they need Max Guard / Max Spirit unlocked to be usable). Advice only; no verdict depends on them.
2026-11-02 raid.bulk_weight: 1 = rank raid/Mega attackers by ER-style effective DPS (damage x (HP*Def)^(1/4), the
GamePress/Pokebattler community method, Shadow pays its -1/6 Defense). 0 = damage only (old behaviour). Max Battles stay damage-only.
2026-11-02 settings: pvp.leagues (1500 Great, 2500 Ultra, 10000 Master) and pvp.cups (little, fantasy) choose what the
sorter plans for. Anything left out gets no builds, teams, wishlist or protection and drops out of the grade.
The viewer's Settings tab edits these and downloads a new pogo_config.json for you to save here and re-run.
2026-11-04 decisive mode: tighter PvP BUILD gates (species top 50/40/25, IV rank 80); search strings use year+!shiny; raid Mega = strongest owned booster; weak redundant Megas demoted.

max_battle.note: Max Battle DPS is an approximation: Max Move type is taken from the Fast Attack type; Max Guard/Max Spirit and Max Move levels are not modelled.
